title: hyprwhspr configuration with local Nemotron streaming

transcription_backend.description: Use the first-class local Nemotron streaming backend.

nemotron_streaming_model.description: Advanced override for a compatible ONNX Runtime GenAI Nemotron export. Only the pinned default export is supported.

nemotron_streaming_revision.description: Pinned Hugging Face revision for the supported Nemotron ONNX export.

nemotron_streaming_device.description: ONNX Runtime execution provider for local Nemotron streaming.

nemotron_streaming_buffer_max_seconds.description: Maximum queued microphone audio before the utterance fails explicitly instead of dropping chunks.

nemotron_streaming_finalize_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for final decoding after recording stops.

nemotron_streaming_use_vad.description: Enable the export's bundled Silero VAD. Off by default pending push-to-talk and short-dictation benchmarks.
